title: SLA Race: Password Spray

wrong.fp: Closed as false positive, but the spray was real: hundreds of failures then an Accepted from one IP is textbook T1110.003.
wrong.escalate: Escalated a ticket L1 owns. A server spray with a clear source is a true positive: document the IOC so the firewall team can block it.

triageBullets: Pattern: failed SSH spray then a single Accepted from one external IP.
No matching change ticket, so it is not a VPN flap.
Recommend: block the source, force MFA, reset the affected account.
